title: Minimalist Dark Text
coreRelationships: The text is the sole visual element against a uniform background.
The text's color provides a subtle contrast against the dark background.
The text is centrally aligned, creating a balanced and static composition.
reuseFormula: Generate a solid dark background. Place a single word in all caps, using a classic serif font, centered on the canvas. Use a mid-dark gray for the text color to create a subtle, low-contrast effect.
